scope: Implementation ownership and written-contract review; not live behavioral proof.

requirements.requirement: Detect Research Phase — Agent harus dapat menentukan phase penelitian dari context yang tersedia.
Preserve Existing Decisions — Agent harus mempertahankan keputusan yang sudah approved/locked kecuali pengguna meminta perubahan atau ada conflict yang perlu diangkat.
Build Research State — Agent harus dapat membangun/update research state dari conversation dan artifacts.
Build Mind-map — Agent harus dapat memetakan hubungan ide -> fenomena -> masalah -> evidence -> research direction -> methodology.
Identify Missing Evidence — Agent harus menunjukkan klaim yang belum memiliki evidence.
Prevent Fabrication — Agent tidak boleh mengarang sumber, data, statistik, atau hasil penelitian.
Assess Feasibility — Agent harus menilai risiko feasibility secara proporsional.
Develop Defensible Titles — Agent harus menghasilkan judul berdasarkan research state.
Explain Title Rationale — Agent harus dapat menjelaskan alasan substantif tiap kandidat judul.
Route Research Type — Agent harus dapat menggunakan route Kuantitatif/Kualitatif/Mixed Method/R&D.
Create State-aware Checklist — Checklist harus menyesuaikan kondisi aktual penelitian.
Read Campus Guideline First — Jika guideline kampus diberikan, agent harus menggunakannya sebagai sumber struktur.
Create Research-aware Outline — Outline harus menjelaskan purpose/evidence/dependencies, bukan heading saja.
Draft Only from Supported State — Drafting harus membedakan READY/PARTIALLY_READY/NOT_READY.
Check Consistency — Agent harus memeriksa dependency antar elemen penelitian.
Detect Contradictions — Agent harus mengangkat mismatch metodologis dan scope.
Propagate Material Changes — Perubahan material harus memicu review bagian terkait.
Handle Supervisor Revision — Agent harus memetakan dampak keputusan pembimbing.
Standalone Runtime — Skill harus dapat digunakan tanpa Andino.
Andino Coexistence — Ketika Andino aktif, skill harus menjadi specialist dan tidak mengambil lifecycle ownership.
Progressive Reference Loading — Agent harus membaca reference yang relevan saja.
Honest Verification — Agent harus membedakan apa yang verified, inferred, assumed, dan belum diperiksa.
Identify Core Title Focus — Agent harus dapat menyatakan fokus utama penelitian sebelum membuat judul definitif.
Select Relevant Title Components — Agent harus dapat memilih variable/factor/concept/object/context yang benar-benar didukung ResearchState.
Decide Method/Context Inclusion — Agent harus menentukan apakah metode, lokasi, populasi, atau periode perlu tampil di judul.
Support Multiple Title Styles — Agent harus mendukung formulasi interogatif, deskriptif, dan deklaratif ketika sesuai.
Generate Substantive Title Variants — Agent harus menghasilkan variasi yang berbeda secara substantif, bukan sinonim kosmetik.
Apply Title Quality Gate — Agent harus memeriksa clarity, alignment, scope, concept fit, method fit, context necessity, feasibility, traceability, readability, dan institution fit.
Explain Title Anatomy — Agent harus dapat menjelaskan fungsi setiap komponen kandidat judul.
Avoid Approval Guarantees — Agent tidak boleh menjanjikan bahwa judul pasti ACC/disukai pembimbing.
Understand Natural User Requests — Agent harus dapat memahami prompt natural tanpa meminta format prompt khusus.
Normalize Intent Internally — Agent boleh menyusun internal IntentPacket tetapi tidak boleh mengubah tujuan atau hard constraint pengguna.
Reuse Available Context — Agent harus memeriksa ResearchState, conversation, file, guideline, dan keputusan aktif sebelum meminta pengguna mengulang informasi.
Ask Only Material Clarifications — Agent hanya meminta klarifikasi ketika ambiguity dapat mengubah outcome secara material dan tidak dapat diselesaikan dari context.
Treat Feedback as Delta — Agent harus menerapkan refinement pada state/output yang ada dan mempertahankan bagian yang masih valid.
Separate Intent from Factual Truth — Agent harus memahami apa yang diinginkan pengguna tanpa otomatis menganggap factual premise pengguna sudah terverifikasi.
Generate Reusable Prompts On Demand — Jika pengguna meminta prompt reusable, agent boleh menyusunnya berdasarkan goal, context, constraint, evidence, output, dan format yang relevan.
Avoid Prompt Ceremony — Agent tidak boleh memaksa Persona/Context/Task/Output/Format atau formula prompt lain pada setiap interaksi jika bahasa natural sudah cukup.
Build BAB I–III Argument Chain — Agent harus menjaga BAB I, BAB II, dan BAB III sebagai dependency chain yang konsisten.
Apply What/Why/How Diagnostic — Agent harus dapat memeriksa apakah problem, rationale, dan method sudah cukup terhubung.
Distinguish Practical Problem and Research Gap — Agent tidak boleh menyamakan masalah praktis dengan research gap tanpa literature evidence.
Verify Gap and Novelty — Gap/novelty harus traceable ke literature dan tidak boleh diarang.
Evaluate Research Question Quality — Agent harus memeriksa clarity, focus, answerability, alignment, method fit, concept fit, feasibility, dan embedded conclusion.
Handle Paradigm Proportionally — Agent hanya menggunakan paradigma/filsafat ketika relevan terhadap design atau guideline.
Maintain Problem Boundaries — Agent harus dapat menjaga focus/context/period/unit dan boundary lain yang material.
Distinguish Fact Hypothesis Concept Theory — Agent harus mencegah category error antar elemen ilmiah tersebut.
Support Progressive Literature Reading — Agent harus dapat melakukan literature triage bertahap tanpa mengklaim itu salinan teknik proprietary sumber.
Apply IMRaD Carefully — Agent dapat memakai IMRaD sebagai communication logic tetapi tidak boleh mengganti guideline proposal kampus atau membuat Result/Discussion fiktif.
Understand Deductive and Inductive Reasoning — Agent harus menggunakan reasoning mode secara proporsional dan tidak memasangkannya secara kaku hanya berdasarkan quantitative/qualitative label.
Select Sampling Strategy — Agent harus memilih probability/non-probability sampling atau participant strategy sesuai design, inference, access, ethics, dan feasibility.
Route Experimental and Non-Experimental Quantitative Designs — Agent harus membedakan design berdasarkan intervention/inference target.
Preserve R&D as Independent Route — Agent tidak boleh memaksa R&D sebagai subset eksperimen kuantitatif jika lifecycle development/evaluation lebih tepat.
Support Mixed Method Convergent and Sequential Logic — Agent harus menjelaskan timing, strand relationship, integration point, dan rationale.
Build Supervisor Expectation State — Agent hanya boleh menyimpulkan ekspektasi dosen dari evidence eksplisit.
Run Proposal Self-Assessment — Agent harus dapat menilai readiness proposal berdasarkan foundation, problem/gap, question, literature, method, consistency, guideline, dan open items.
Enforce Results Readiness Gate — Agent tidak boleh menulis factual results tanpa data/analysis evidence yang tersedia.
Build Finding Registry — Agent harus memetakan setiap material finding ke RQ/objective, source data, analysis, output, uncertainty, dan presentation artifact.
Write Objective Results — Agent harus dapat menyajikan hasil/temuan secara jelas tanpa fabricated interpretation/data.
Preserve Results–Discussion Boundary — Agent harus mengikuti separate/combined structure sesuai guideline sambil mempertahankan perbedaan fungsi observation dan interpretation.
Report Material Null and Unexpected Findings — Agent tidak boleh cherry-pick hanya finding yang mendukung expectation.
Distinguish Statistical and Practical Importance — Agent tidak boleh memperlakukan p-value sebagai effect magnitude.
Enforce Causal Claim Gate — Agent harus membatasi causal wording sesuai design dan evidence.
Build Discussion from Findings — Discussion harus berasal dari finding registry, bukan literature prose generik.
Compare Findings with Literature Fairly — Agent harus mempertimbangkan supporting dan contrasting evidence yang relevan.
Mark Explanation Evidence Status — Penjelasan unexpected/contradictory result harus ditandai sebagai verified, plausible, atau unknown.
Track Limitations and Uncertainty — Agent harus menjelaskan bagaimana limitation memengaruhi interpretation/generalization.
Derive Implications — Theoretical/practical/methodological implications harus traceable ke findings.
Build Conclusion from RQ/Objectives — Setiap conclusion claim material harus dapat dipetakan ke research question/objective dan finding.
Prevent New Results in Conclusion — Agent tidak boleh memperkenalkan hasil baru di Conclusion.
Derive Recommendations — Recommendation/future research harus berasal dari finding, limitation, unresolved question, atau scope boundary.
Maintain BAB I–V Consistency — Agent harus dapat memeriksa full thesis chain dari problem sampai conclusion.
Preserve Analysis Provenance — Angka/theme/quote/table/figure yang ditulis harus dapat ditelusuri ke analysis/source artifact.

Build Methodology Decision Stack — Agent harus dapat memetakan keputusan philosophy/assumption, theory approach, methodological choice, strategy, time horizon, dan techniques/procedures secara coherent.
Check Methodology Coherence — Agent harus mendeteksi mismatch antar-layer dan research question.
Distinguish Gap Spotting and Problematization — Agent harus membedakan missing-knowledge framing dari assumption-challenging framing.
Build Literature Synthesis Matrix — Agent harus mengorganisasi verified sources untuk comparison/synthesis, bukan summary list.
Build State-of-the-Art Map — Agent harus memetakan established knowledge, disputes, method patterns, shifts, and unresolved issues dari evidence yang cukup.
Create Model-Dependent Analysis Plan — Agent tidak boleh memakai urutan statistik universal; sequence mengikuti measurement, design, model, assumptions, dan inference.
Select Primary Data Technique — Agent harus memilih technique berdasarkan evidence need, behavior/experience target, inference, access, ethics, dan feasibility.
Evaluate Secondary Data Fitness — Agent harus memeriksa provenance, coverage, definition, time, quality, license/access, privacy, dan fitness for RQ.
Build Data Source Decision Tree — Agent harus dapat memilih primary/secondary/combined data route secara traceable.
Build Theory-to-Framework Traceability — Setiap construct/arrow/proposition/hypothesis harus memiliki theoretical/empirical rationale.
Avoid Fixed Hypothesis Count — Agent tidak boleh memaksa empat atau jumlah tertentu hypothesis tanpa design rationale.
Run Research Ethics Gate — Agent harus memeriksa consent, participant risk, privacy, data governance, power imbalance, approval/access, dan relevant ethics issues.
Run Secondary Data Ethics Check — Public availability tidak boleh dianggap otomatis bebas ethical/privacy concern.
Preserve Research Integrity — Agent harus mencegah fabrication, falsification, selective reporting, plagiarism, and misleading manipulation.
Run Journal Due Diligence — Agent harus menggunakan multiple signals untuk mengevaluasi venue dan tidak hanya satu list atau indexing claim.
Avoid Unsupported Predatory Label — Agent harus membedakan red flags, unverified claims, dan confirmed information sebelum memberi characterization pada journal/publisher.
Detect Defense Type — Agent harus membedakan seminar proposal dan sidang akhir serta menyesuaikan scope pertanyaan.
Resolve Defense Protocol — Agent harus menggunakan protocol/rubric institusi bila tersedia dan tidak mengarang format.
Build Defense Brief — Agent harus membuat compressed research representation dari state aktual.
Generate Dynamic Potential Questions — Agent harus dapat menghasilkan 50+ pertanyaan original bila diminta, berbasis thesis state, BAB I–V, weakness, dan research-design concerns.

Parse Examiner Question Intent — Agent harus membedakan clarification, justification, evidence, consistency, alternative, boundary, limitation, contribution, process, interpretation, dan revision signals.
Decompose Compound Questions — Agent harus membantu memecah pertanyaan panjang menjadi subquestions tanpa kehilangan inti.
Build Evidence-Grounded Answer — Jawaban harus memprioritaskan direct answer, rationale, thesis evidence, dan boundary.
Prevent Defense Bluffing — Agent tidak boleh mengarang evidence/jawaban hanya agar terdengar meyakinkan.
Handle Unknown Answers — Agent harus mendukung jawaban yang jujur mengenai unknown/out-of-scope sambil menunjukkan apa yang memang dapat dijawab.
Handle False Premise Respectfully — Agent harus dapat mengklarifikasi premis yang keliru tanpa menjadi defensif.
Generate Follow-Up Questions — Mock defense harus menghasilkan follow-up berdasarkan kelemahan jawaban dan thesis state.
Run Adaptive Mock Defense — Agent harus bertanya satu per satu, mengevaluasi respons, dan menyesuaikan difficulty.
Build High-Risk Question Radar — Agent harus memprioritaskan potential questions dari inconsistency, weak evidence, limitation, dan methodological vulnerability.
Avoid Script Memorization Dependency — Answer cards harus menjadi reasoning scaffold, bukan script wajib.
Adapt by Academic Level Carefully — Agent harus menggunakan institutional expectations terlebih dahulu dan generic S1/S2/S3 heuristic hanya sebagai fallback.
Capture Examiner Feedback — Agent harus memisahkan actual feedback, interpretation, required revision, dan ambiguity.
Propagate Post-Defense Revisions — Examiner revisions harus memicu cross-chapter/state impact review.
Run Defense Readiness Gate — Agent harus memeriksa foundation, method, findings, discussion, consistency, Q&A, dan protocol sebelum menyatakan readiness.
Run Quantitative Fit Gate — Agent harus memeriksa apakah quantitative approach sesuai research question/evidence need.
Build Construct-to-Variable Traceability — Agent harus menghubungkan concept/construct ke operational definition dan variable.
Avoid Forced X/Y Framing — Agent tidak boleh memaksa independent/dependent variable pada quantitative design yang tidak memerlukannya.
Route Quantitative Design Family — Agent harus membedakan descriptive, associational, comparative, longitudinal, experimental, quasi-experimental, dan evaluation-oriented designs.
Build Survey Plan — Agent harus memetakan population, sampling/frame, questionnaire, mode, response/nonresponse, data quality, dan analysis.
Build Experiment Plan — Agent harus memetakan intervention, comparator, assignment, outcome, timing, threat/limitation, ethics, dan analysis.
Build Sampling Rationale — Agent harus menjelaskan population, frame, strategy, sample-size rationale, dan generalization limits.
Evaluate Quantitative Measurement — Agent harus memeriksa construct fit, operationalization, instrument source/adaptation, validity/reliability evidence, dan scoring.
Build Variable Dictionary — Agent harus menyimpan meaning, coding, type, source, role, missing convention, dan unit variable.
Pre-Specify Quantitative Analysis — Agent harus menyusun analysis plan sebelum data collection/inspection jika memungkinkan.
Distinguish Descriptive and Inferential Goals — Agent tidak boleh melakukan inferential analysis hanya karena data berbentuk numerik.
Select Analysis from Design and Estimand — Agent harus mempertimbangkan RQ, estimand, design, outcome, structure, assumptions, dan inference.
Interpret P-Values Correctly — Agent tidak boleh menyebut p-value sebagai probability hypothesis benar atau sebagai effect magnitude.
Interpret Non-Significance Carefully — Agent tidak boleh menyimpulkan "tidak ada effect/relationship" hanya dari non-significant result.
Report Effect and Uncertainty — Jika relevan, agent harus mempertimbangkan estimate, effect magnitude, interval/uncertainty, dan practical meaning.
Handle Missing Data Explicitly — Agent harus memeriksa quantity/pattern/cause dan rationale penanganan missing data.
Prevent Outcome-Driven Data Cleaning — Agent tidak boleh menghapus/mengubah data hanya untuk memperbaiki significance.
Run Quantitative Planning Gate — Agent harus memeriksa problem, question, theory/variables, design, sample, measurement, data, dan analysis sebelum quantitative study dianggap siap.
Detect Literature Task Mode — Agent harus membedakan quick discovery, targeted evidence search, thesis literature review, SOTA mapping, paper reading, dan systematic review.
Build Search Concept Blocks — Agent harus menerjemahkan RQ/evidence need menjadi concept/synonym blocks.
Build Boolean Search Strategy — Agent harus menggunakan AND/OR/NOT, nesting, phrase, dan syntax lain secara tepat.
Adapt Search Syntax per Database — Agent tidak boleh menganggap syntax satu database berlaku universal.
Maintain Search Log — Agent harus menyimpan source, exact query, date, filters, result count, dan material revisions.
Justify Search Restrictions — Date/language/document filters harus memiliki rationale bila material.
Deduplicate Carefully — Agent harus menangani duplicate records tanpa mencampur distinct reports/studies.
Apply Screening Criteria — Title/abstract/full-text decisions harus traceable ke relevance/eligibility criteria.
Avoid Premature Exclusion — Ambiguous records harus dapat masuk MAYBE/full-text review daripada dibuang dari title saja.
Route Reading Depth — Agent harus menentukan Stage 1–4 berdasarkan relevance, paper role, dan evidence need.
Build Paper Reading Card — Agent harus mengekstrak bibliographic identity, question, design, sample/context, measurement, analysis, result, limitation, claim, role, dan relevance dengan provenance.
Distinguish Author Claim and Evidence — Agent harus memisahkan author interpretation, reported data/result, dan agent inference.
Require Full-Text Verification for Material Details — Abstract-only evidence tidak boleh disamarkan sebagai full-text verified evidence.
Support Citation Chaining — Agent boleh melakukan backward/forward citation searching dan mencatat hasilnya.
Build Cross-Paper Synthesis — Agent harus menghasilkan synthesis dari comparison antar-paper, bukan daftar ringkasan.
Detect Systematic Review Requirements — Agent tidak boleh melabel workflow sebagai systematic review tanpa method requirements.
Preserve Systematic Review Reproducibility — Search, screening, extraction, and flow counts harus dapat diaudit.
Use PRISMA Appropriately — Agent harus memahami PRISMA sebagai reporting guideline, bukan protocol/quality certificate.
Use PRISMA-S Appropriately — Jika applicable, literature search reporting harus cukup detail untuk reproduksi.
Prevent Fabricated Review Counts — Agent tidak boleh membuat PRISMA/search/screening counts yang tidak berasal dari registry aktual.
Respect Retractions and Corrections — Agent harus memperhatikan retraction/correction status ketika material dan tools memungkinkan.
Run Progressive Literature Readiness Gate — Agent harus memeriksa search, screening, reading, synthesis, dan systematic-review readiness.
Clarity — Instruksi skill harus ringkas, tidak berulang, dan mudah dipahami agent.
Portability — Skill tidak boleh bergantung pada satu vendor/model/host tanpa kebutuhan yang jelas.
Progressive Disclosure — Detail domain tidak memenuhi `SKILL.md` secara berlebihan.
Traceability — Keputusan penting harus dapat ditelusuri ke user instruction, guideline, supervisor decision, evidence, atau methodology.
Safety Against Academic Fabrication — Skill harus memiliki guardrail eksplisit terhadap fabricated academic evidence.
Maintainability — Reference dipisahkan berdasarkan concern sehingga modul baru dapat ditambah tanpa menulis ulang seluruh skill.
Testability — Core behavior harus dapat direpresentasikan dalam positive dan negative eval cases.
No Hidden Universal Assumptions — Template generik tidak boleh dipresentasikan sebagai aturan semua kampus/metode.
Minimal Context Waste — Jangan load seluruh knowledge base jika task hanya membutuhkan satu bagian.

Human Decision Ownership — Keputusan material mengenai topik, scope, pembimbing, metode yang belum pasti, dan perubahan besar harus tetap jelas sebagai keputusan pengguna/peneliti, bukan disamarkan sebagai kepastian agent.
Natural Language Usability — User experience tidak boleh bergantung pada kemampuan pengguna melakukan prompt engineering.
Intent Fidelity — Interpretasi internal harus mempertahankan makna, scope, dan constraint pengguna.
Low-friction Refinement — Feedback singkat harus dapat digunakan untuk merevisi output tanpa restart yang tidak perlu.
No Prompt-length Bias — Jangan menganggap prompt panjang otomatis lebih berkualitas daripada prompt singkat yang context-nya sudah cukup.
Methodological Traceability — Setiap methodological recommendation harus dapat ditelusuri ke research question, evidence need, guideline, or explicit constraint.
No Fake Novelty — Skill tidak boleh mengemas perbedaan kosmetik sebagai novelty.
Proposal Cross-Chapter Consistency — BAB I–III harus dapat diperiksa sebagai satu model penelitian.
Source-Bounded Reconstruction — Nama capability publik boleh diadaptasi, tetapi detail proprietary yang tidak tersedia tidak boleh direkonstruksi dari tebakan.
Result Provenance — Setiap hasil empiris material harus memiliki provenance ke data/analysis artifact.
Interpretation Discipline — Agent harus membedakan observation, interpretation, explanation, dan implication.
No Selective Reporting by Default — Skill tidak boleh menyembunyikan material null/negative/unexpected findings hanya karena tidak sesuai expectation.
Conclusion Conservatism — Kesimpulan harus sama atau lebih sempit daripada evidence dan design, tidak lebih luas.
Cross-Chapter Traceability — Perubahan pada results/discussion/conclusion harus dapat dipropagasikan ke thesis consistency checks.
Methodological Coherence — Advanced terminology tidak boleh menggantikan logical fit antar keputusan metodologi.
Literature Synthesis over Enumeration — Literature review advanced harus memprioritaskan cross-source synthesis.
Model-Specific Statistical Discipline — Assumption checks dan test sequence harus sesuai model, bukan ritual statistik.
Data Provenance and Fitness — Data source harus dinilai dari asal, kualitas, coverage, access, ethics, dan fit terhadap RQ.
Ethics by Design — Ethics/privacy/data governance harus dipertimbangkan sepanjang lifecycle.
Venue Due-Diligence Caution — Assessment journal/publisher harus multi-signal dan tidak membuat tuduhan definitif dari indikasi terbatas.
Defense Grounding — Potential questions dan answers harus berasal dari thesis/research state, bukan daftar generik saja.
Oral Directness — Jawaban latihan harus mengutamakan jawaban inti sebelum penjelasan panjang.
No Confidence Theater — Skill tidak boleh mengganti evidence yang lemah dengan bahasa yang terdengar lebih yakin.
Question Diversity — Mock defense harus memvariasikan wording dan follow-up agar user memahami reasoning.
Examiner Intent Humility — Agent tidak boleh mengklaim mengetahui motif personal penguji tanpa evidence.
Defense-to-Revision Continuity — Catatan seminar/sidang harus dapat diteruskan menjadi revision state yang actionable.
Beginner-Friendly Quantitative Reasoning — Konsep statistik/metodologi harus dijelaskan dengan bahasa yang dapat dipahami pemula tanpa mengorbankan ketepatan.
No Statistical Ritual — Test, assumption check, dan reliability procedure tidak boleh dijalankan hanya karena lazim.
Design-before-Test — Pemilihan analysis harus mengikuti design dan target inference.
Measurement Traceability — Setiap quantitative variable material harus dapat dilacak ke construct/data source.
Quantitative Inference Humility — Generalization dan causal claim harus mengikuti sampling/design, bukan gaya bahasa.
Search Reproducibility — Material literature searches harus dapat ditelusuri ke source/query/date/filter.
Progressive Reading Efficiency — Reading depth harus proporsional terhadap relevance dan evidence need.
Evidence Provenance — Paper-derived claim material harus mempertahankan source dan verification depth.
No Abstract Overreach — Abstract tidak boleh digunakan seolah memberi semua detail full-text.
Synthesis over Paper Listing — Literature output harus bergerak dari extraction menuju comparison/synthesis.
Review-Type Integrity — Systematic review terminology hanya digunakan jika workflow benar-benar mendukungnya.
Search Syntax Portability Awareness — Agent harus menganggap query translation antar-database sebagai explicit step.

Agent mengevaluasi instrument/measurement sesuai construct/context.
Agent dapat membuat Variable Dictionary.
Agent membuat analysis plan sebelum data collection jika memungkinkan.
Agent membedakan descriptive, estimation, dan inferential goal.
Agent memilih analysis dari RQ/design/data/assumptions.
Agent tidak memilih test hanya dari nama variable/software menu.
Agent menginterpretasikan p-value secara benar.
Agent tidak menganggap non-significant = no effect.
Agent mempertimbangkan estimate/effect/uncertainty/practical meaning.
Agent menangani missing data secara explicit.
Agent tidak membersihkan data berdasarkan desired significance.
Agent dapat menjalankan Quantitative Research Planning Gate.
Agent dapat mengubah RQ menjadi search concept blocks.
Agent dapat membangun Boolean query dan menjelaskan fungsi AND/OR/NOT.
Agent tidak menggunakan NOT secara agresif tanpa risk check.
Agent menerjemahkan query sesuai database/interface.
Agent mencatat source/query/date/filter/result count.
Agent dapat melakukan deduplication dan screening secara traceable.
Agent tidak membuang record ambigu hanya dari title.
Agent menjalankan four-stage progressive reading original.
Agent tidak menjanjikan semua paper dapat dipahami dalam lima menit.
Agent membuat Paper Reading Card dengan provenance.

capabilities.name: Systematic Review Planning / Search / Screening Support

tasks.objective: **Re-inspect repository state.** Record current default branch, branch heads, working tree, branch list, applicable instruction files, and relevant quality-layer files.
tasks.acceptance: Repository baseline contains exact SHAs/status and identifies any drift affecting this plan.
tasks.validation: Git status/branch/tree inspection; repository instruction scan.

tasks.objective: **Verify distribution/control-plane contract.** Confirm runtime packages remain branch-root packages and `main` remains quality/control plane; inspect any new package convention since planning.
tasks.acceptance: Current architecture either matches this plan or a concrete drift item is recorded before mutation.
tasks.validation: Tree comparison and targeted file reads.

tasks.objective: **Reconcile plan traceability with current SRS artifact.** Verify this GRAND-PLAN still maps all 146 FRs, 47 NFRs, 142 SRS acceptance criteria, and 110 initial eval cases from the supplied v0.9 artifact.
tasks.acceptance: Counts and IDs match this plan or drift is explicitly reported.
tasks.validation: Scripted/text comparison or manual index check.

tasks.objective: **Create local distribution branch/package skeleton.** Create a non-orphan branch named `skripsi-skill` following the verified root-package distribution pattern; add only the minimal valid runtime files needed for the first vertical slice.
tasks.acceptance: Package has valid `name: skripsi-skill`, nonempty specific description, README, and no ceremonial empty directories/files.
tasks.validation: Repository validator after P1-T02; manual Agent Skills spec check.

tasks.objective: **Extend validator for the third skill and assets.** Make the smallest deterministic change that validates `skripsi-skill` plus its allowed `assets/` while preserving existing stricter behavior for current packages.
tasks.acceptance: Validator can target three refs; existing two packages still pass unchanged; `skripsi-skill` allows intended references/assets and still rejects unexpected paths/broken links/invalid frontmatter.
tasks.validation: Unit tests plus local validator against all three refs.

tasks.objective: **Expand validator unit coverage.** Add tests for third-skill identity, allowed asset paths, forbidden unexpected runtime paths, broken links involving assets/references, and preservation of existing failure cases.
tasks.acceptance: New tests fail before/fix after as applicable; all pre-existing tests remain green.
tasks.validation: `python3 -m unittest discover -s tests` or current repo command.

tasks.objective: **Wire control-plane metadata and CI.** Add `skripsi-skill` to the distribution table, add an eval JSON bootstrap with at least one behavior and one negative-trigger case, and update CI fetch/validation to include the new ref.
tasks.acceptance: Main quality layer names all three skills; workflow fetch command/ref list includes `skripsi-skill`; eval schema remains compatible.
tasks.validation: YAML review, local validator/tests; remote run only after authorization.

tasks.objective: **Run foundation deterministic checks.** Establish a clean structural baseline before behavioral content expands.
tasks.acceptance: All executed deterministic checks pass or failures are triaged as pre-existing/new; no live behavior claim is made.
tasks.validation: Repo validator; unit tests; `git diff --check` or verified equivalent.

tasks.objective: **Define thin SKILL orchestration contract.** Write activation, lifecycle boundary, source hierarchy, core state behavior, evidence rules, progressive routing, and return behavior without embedding full methodology.
tasks.acceptance: SKILL identifies when to activate/not activate, how to enter current state, what is authoritative, and which references to load for each route.
tasks.validation: Repo validator; manual routing review; line/token-size review.

tasks.objective: **Implement ResearchState and phase-routing contract.** Define state fields/statuses, phase detection, adaptive entry, preservation of approved/locked decisions, open questions/blockers, output/next-action semantics, and state update rules.
tasks.acceptance: Agent can reconstruct/update only relevant state, preserve approved decisions, and identify current phase without restarting.
tasks.validation: Manual contract review; EVAL-001,002 and related state scenarios.

tasks.objective: **Implement natural-language intent/context resolution.** Define internal intent normalization, context lookup order, material clarification, feedback-as-delta, and separation of intent from factual truth.
tasks.acceptance: Short/natural requests route correctly; hard constraints persist; material ambiguity triggers focused clarification; harmless ambiguity does not block.

tasks.objective: **Implement evidence, guideline, and no-fabrication contract.** Define evidence classes, verification depth, missing-evidence behavior, source hierarchy, campus guideline handling, supervisor decision handling, and explicit forbidden fabrications.
tasks.acceptance: Unsupported claims are labeled; campus guideline overrides internal generic structure within its scope; missing evidence remains visible.
tasks.validation: EVAL-003,004 plus fabrication cases; manual source-hierarchy conflict review.

tasks.objective: **Establish standalone/Andino lifecycle boundary.** Encode standalone ownership and the early Andino specialist contract so later features cannot accidentally create a second lifecycle.
tasks.acceptance: Standalone use is not blocked by missing Andino; active Andino retains plan/checkpoint/completion ownership.
tasks.validation: Supplemental Andino behavior eval + manual comparison with current Andino routing/handoff docs.

tasks.objective: **Add core activation/evidence eval coverage.** Populate relevant SRS cases for raw topic, approved state, campus guideline, missing evidence, routing basics, simple-edit negative trigger, intent/context cases, plus supplemental unrelated/coding negative triggers and unavailable-tool behavior.
tasks.acceptance: Eval file passes schema and covers both behavior and negative-trigger kinds.
tasks.validation: Repo validator + semantic review; selected live smoke if environment available.

tasks.objective: **Validate core vertical slice.** Exercise a minimal path from natural user request → current state → evidence gap → next action, in standalone and Andino-bound contexts.
tasks.acceptance: Core path produces traceable state and no fabricated evidence; negative triggers do not over-activate.
tasks.validation: Manual/live agent smoke in disposable context where available; otherwise mark UNVERIFIED.

tasks.objective: **Implement research mind-map and feasibility gate.** Define flexible reasoning map and feasibility outcomes without fake numerical scoring.
tasks.acceptance: Mind-map distinguishes unknown/evidence states and feasibility exposes material risks before a direction is treated as mature.
tasks.validation: EVAL-001 plus feasibility-specific SRS acceptance checks; manual examples across research types.

tasks.objective: **Implement structured title development.** Define core-focus extraction, title anatomy, optional method/context inclusion, substantive variants, styles, rationale, scope/causal wording gate, and no-ACC guarantee.
tasks.acceptance: Candidate titles trace to problem/RQ/object/method/scope; unsupported causal terms are rejected or reframed.

tasks.objective: **Implement state-aware checklist and consistency matrix.** Create progress/checklist statuses and dependency checks linking RQ→objective→data→method→analysis plus core thesis chain.
tasks.acceptance: Completed/pending/blocked items reflect actual state; contradictions are surfaced with affected elements.
tasks.validation: EVAL-009 and relevant acceptance checks; manual matrix review.

tasks.objective: **Implement proposal outline and drafting-readiness contract.** Generate guideline-first outline; fallback generic structure is provisional; each outline section acts as writing contract with purpose/questions/evidence/dependencies/forbidden shortcuts/completion criteria.
tasks.acceptance: Outline follows supplied guideline when present and identifies unsupported sections/evidence gaps before drafting.

tasks.objective: **Add discovery/title/proposal-entry evals.** Complete SRS cases 11–16 and reinforce cases 1–4/9 around the vertical slice.
tasks.acceptance: All relevant cases present, schema-valid, and mapped to implementation owners.
tasks.validation: Validator + semantic review + selected live evaluation.

tasks.objective: **Checkpoint first usable vertical slice.** Validate idea/current-state entry through proposal outline without invoking later advanced engines unnecessarily.
tasks.acceptance: Slice is useful, state-preserving, evidence-safe, and routes only required references.
tasks.validation: Live/manual scenario review with context-load observation.

tasks.objective: **Implement problem/gap/novelty/RQ reasoning.** Define problem diagnostics, gap-vs-practical-problem distinction, literature-evidence requirement for novelty, and RQ answerability/quality gate.
tasks.acceptance: RQ/gap/novelty statements expose evidence basis and method/data answerability.

tasks.objective: **Implement scientific reasoning and boundary rules.** Define proportional paradigm/philosophy use, fact/hypothesis/concept/theory distinctions, deductive/inductive reasoning, IMRaD as communication logic only, and scope boundaries.
tasks.acceptance: Reasoning choices have explicit purpose; IMRaD never overrides campus structure.

tasks.objective: **Implement baseline research-design routing.** Define non-keyword routing for quantitative, qualitative, mixed method, and R&D, including experiment/non-experiment distinction and mixed-method integration logic.
tasks.acceptance: Each route states applicability, incompatible assumptions, required evidence/data, and integration logic.

tasks.objective: **Implement sampling/participant and supervisor-expectation contracts.** Define sampling/participant rationale at proposal level and a supervisor-expectation state based only on guideline/rubric/feedback evidence.
tasks.acceptance: Selection strategy is justified by design/inference; supervisor preference is never guessed from identity/stereotype.

tasks.objective: **Implement proposal self-assessment and BAB I–III dependency checks.** Define readiness review across problem/RQ/objectives/literature/design/data/analysis/guideline/evidence.
tasks.acceptance: Proposal readiness has concrete missing/contradictory items and next action.
tasks.validation: EVAL-034 plus SRS proposal acceptance criteria.

tasks.objective: **Add proposal/methodology eval cluster.** Implement SRS cases 24–34 and any earlier route cases not yet represented.
tasks.acceptance: Cluster covers unsupported novelty, RQ mismatch, guideline conflict, unknown proprietary term, sampling, mixed/R&D routing, supervisor expectations, fact/hypothesis, readiness.
tasks.validation: Validator + semantic review + representative live cases.

tasks.objective: **Validate proposal vertical slice.** Test approved/current research state → BAB I–III reasoning → method route → outline/readiness with at least one scenario per research type.
tasks.acceptance: All four routes preserve shared core contracts without forcing irrelevant fields.

tasks.objective: **Implement literature task-mode and search-strategy contract.** Route quick lookup/narrative discovery/gap search/systematic-review planning; translate RQ/evidence need into concept/synonym blocks and Boolean strategy; require database/interface-specific syntax translation.
tasks.acceptance: Search plan records concepts, source/interface, exact query, date, filters, result count when available, and iteration rationale.

tasks.objective: **Implement deduplication, eligibility, screening, and reading queue.** Define title/abstract/full-text screening layers, explicit eligibility/exclusion reasons, role/relevance/quality distinctions, and triage queue.
tasks.acceptance: Screening state is traceable and ambiguous cases are escalated to deeper review rather than silently excluded.

tasks.objective: **Implement original four-stage progressive reading and Paper Reading Card.** Define stages: relevance scan; structure/claim map; method/evidence read; synthesis/research integration; capture source identity, claim, data/result, interpretation, limitation, relevance, verification depth.
tasks.acceptance: Reading depth matches task; important papers have traceable cards and material claims show verification depth.

tasks.objective: **Implement citation chaining with bounded purpose.** Define backward/forward citation chasing as supplementary discovery, with provenance and stopping rationale.
tasks.acceptance: Chained papers are tagged with discovery route and screened through normal criteria.

tasks.objective: **Implement cross-paper synthesis and state-of-the-art integration.** Define extraction-to-comparison workflow, synthesis matrix, supporting/contrasting evidence, gaps/limitations, and integration into ResearchState.
tasks.acceptance: Synthesis claims cite multiple extracted evidence units where appropriate and distinguish disagreement/limitations.
tasks.validation: EVAL-110 plus advanced synthesis cases reused in P7.

tasks.objective: **Implement systematic-review mode gate and reporting integrity.** Define protocol/search/eligibility/screening/extraction/reporting prerequisites; PRISMA as reporting guidance and PRISMA-S for search reporting; actual registry counts only; retraction/correction handling when tools allow.
tasks.acceptance: Systematic mode only activates when prerequisites are met; counts derive from actual registry; limitations/tool access are explicit.

tasks.objective: **Add literature eval cluster.** Implement all SRS cases 94–110.
tasks.acceptance: All 17 cases schema-valid and owned by a concrete reference/asset behavior.
tasks.validation: Validator + semantic review + live representative cases.

tasks.objective: **Validate literature vertical slice.** Run RQ→search concepts→query/log→screen→read card→synthesis; separately test systematic-review rejection when prerequisites are absent.
tasks.acceptance: End-to-end artifacts are traceable and mode labels are honest.

tasks.objective: **Implement quantitative fit and design-family routing.** Define fit gate and route descriptive, associational, comparative, longitudinal/evaluation, experimental, quasi-experimental designs from RQ/inference target.
tasks.acceptance: Design family rationale identifies target inference and limitations; causal language matches design.

tasks.objective: **Implement construct, variable, operationalization, and measurement chain.** Define conceptual vs operational definitions, variable roles only where meaningful, instrument selection/adaptation evidence, and variable dictionary.
tasks.acceptance: Each measured construct has rationale, operationalization, scale/data properties, source/adaptation status, and unresolved validity concerns.

tasks.objective: **Implement survey, population, frame, sampling, and sample-size planning.** Define survey decision chain and sample rationale based on design/inference rather than magic numbers.
tasks.acceptance: Plan records population, frame/access, strategy, rationale, limitations, and sample-size basis appropriate to design.

tasks.objective: **Implement experiment/quasi-experiment planning.** Define intervention/comparison, assignment/allocation, pre/post structure, threats to validity, outcome measurement, and distinction from simple pre/post survey.
tasks.acceptance: Experiment label and causal ambition match actual assignment/control structure; limitations explicit.

tasks.objective: **Implement analysis planning and statistical interpretation discipline.** Pre-specify outcome/estimand/analysis logic; distinguish descriptive, estimation, inferential/hypothesis-testing goals; model-dependent assumptions; p-value, non-significance, effect magnitude, uncertainty; missing data and cleaning rules.
tasks.acceptance: Analysis choice traces to RQ/design/data/estimand/assumptions; interpretation avoids probability-of-hypothesis errors and overclaim.

tasks.objective: **Implement quantitative planning readiness gate.** Aggregate design, sampling, measurement, collection, analysis, ethics, and feasibility readiness before quantitative execution.
tasks.dependencies: P6-T02–P6-T05,P7 ethics once available; initial gate may link forward.
tasks.acceptance: Gate outputs READY/conditional/not-ready with concrete dependencies and no cosmetic score.
tasks.validation: EVAL-093 and SRS quantitative acceptance criteria.

tasks.objective: **Add and validate quantitative eval cluster.** Implement SRS cases 78–93 and run representative live scenarios.
tasks.acceptance: All 16 cases have owners and expected/forbidden behavior; critical overclaim cases pass live where possible.

tasks.objective: **Implement methodology decision stack and coherence gate.** Represent linked decisions from philosophical/theory-development stance through design/time horizon/data/analysis only when useful; test cross-layer coherence.
tasks.acceptance: Every included layer has a decision effect and conflicts are surfaced.

tasks.objective: **Implement gap spotting vs problematization and SOTA bridge.** Define proportional use of gap spotting/problematisation based on literature evidence and explicit assumptions; connect synthesis to state-of-the-art claims.
tasks.acceptance: Gap/problematisation/SOTA claims show evidence chain and limitation.

tasks.objective: **Implement primary/secondary data source decision logic.** Choose data source by evidence need, inference, provenance, access, fitness, ethics/license, quality, and feasibility.
tasks.acceptance: Decision tree records alternatives/rationale and known limitations.

tasks.objective: **Implement theory→framework→proposition/hypothesis traceability.** Define theory/mechanism/construct/concept links and optional hypotheses; prohibit fixed hypothesis count and box-arrow diagrams without mechanism.
tasks.acceptance: Framework elements trace to theory/evidence and RQ; arrows/relationships have mechanism/rationale.

tasks.objective: **Implement ethics, privacy/data-governance, and research-integrity gate.** Cover participant protection, consent where applicable, sensitive data, power imbalance, secondary-data ethics, license/access, data security, and honesty of research records.
tasks.acceptance: Material ethics obligations/unknowns are surfaced and linked to design/data handling.

tasks.objective: **Implement journal/publisher due diligence.** Use multi-signal checks for publisher/journal identity, peer-review/editorial transparency, indexing claims, fees/policies/provenance as available; no single blacklist verdict.
tasks.acceptance: Due-diligence report lists checked signals/sources and bounded conclusion.

tasks.objective: **Add and validate advanced-methodology eval cluster.** Implement SRS cases 50–62 and live/manual representative review.
tasks.acceptance: 13 cases covered; forbidden methodological rituals/authority claims are rejected.

tasks.objective: **Implement Results Readiness Gate and Finding Registry.** Require actual analysis/evidence before results drafting; register each finding with provenance to data/analysis/RQ/objective.
tasks.acceptance: Results drafting is blocked/partial when evidence missing; each finding identifies source and analysis status.

tasks.objective: **Implement results/findings presentation boundary.** Define objective reporting and guideline-aware separate/combined Results/Discussion behavior across quant/qual/mixed/R&D; table/figure/quote/theme use without redundant narration.
tasks.acceptance: Output identifies finding vs interpretation and maps each to RQ/objective.

tasks.objective: **Implement discussion reasoning and claim gates.** Interpret findings, compare supporting/contrasting literature, handle null/unexpected findings, mark explanation evidence status, enforce causal boundary and statistical/practical/uncertainty distinctions.
tasks.acceptance: Discussion claims trace to finding + relevant literature/theory + design boundary.

tasks.objective: **Implement limitation, implication, conclusion, and recommendation traceability.** Derive conclusion from RQ/objective/findings/discussion; no new results; implications/limitations/recommendations bounded by evidence.
tasks.acceptance: Each RQ/objective has a conclusion path; no conclusion claim lacks earlier support.

tasks.objective: **Implement BAB I–V consistency and revision propagation.** Extend consistency matrix/change-impact rules across title/problem/RQ/objective/theory/method/data/analysis/findings/discussion/conclusion; support supervisor revision loops.
tasks.acceptance: Material revisions create impact map and invalidate/recheck dependent state as necessary.

tasks.objective: **Add and validate BAB IV–V eval cluster.** Implement SRS cases 35–49 and cross-run supervisor/contradiction cases.
tasks.acceptance: Cases have owners and forbidden behaviors observable.
tasks.validation: Validator + semantic review + live/manual fixture cases.

tasks.objective: **Implement defense mode/protocol and Defense Brief.** Differentiate seminar proposal/final defense; resolve campus protocol/rubric if available; summarize current research state, method, findings, contribution, limitations, weak points.
tasks.acceptance: Brief reflects actual current execution state and labels protocol unknowns.

tasks.objective: **Implement dynamic question generation and risk prioritization.** Generate thesis-specific questions by chapter/concern/weakness; support large banks on request without reconstructing proprietary lists; prioritize high-risk questions.
tasks.acceptance: Questions trace to thesis area/concern and include why they matter.

tasks.objective: **Implement examiner-intent parsing and answer-card contract.** Parse clarification/justification/method/findings/limitation/etc.; decompose compound questions; answer direct→rationale→thesis evidence→boundary→close; handle false premise/unknown honestly.
tasks.acceptance: Answer cards cite thesis evidence or explicitly identify unknown/out-of-scope.

tasks.objective: **Implement adaptive mock defense with follow-ups and feedback.** Ask one question at a time, adapt follow-ups to answer, assess directness/evidence/consistency/boundary/clarity, avoid script memorization.
tasks.acceptance: Follow-up changes based on previous answer; feedback cites observable response quality.

tasks.objective: **Implement readiness gate and examiner-feedback revision capture.** Assess unresolved high-risk questions/evidence gaps/consistency; convert actual examiner comments into revision state/impact map after seminar/sidang.
tasks.acceptance: Readiness reports blockers/risks; post-defense comments propagate through dependencies.

tasks.objective: **Add and validate defense eval cluster.** Implement SRS cases 63–77 and run a mock-defense vertical slice.
tasks.acceptance: All 15 cases covered and critical no-bluff/current-state behaviors demonstrated.

tasks.objective: **Audit standalone ownership across all routes.** Verify every capability has a valid host-normal completion/next-action behavior without requiring Andino.
tasks.acceptance: Standalone scenarios complete or checkpoint using host context and preserve ResearchState.
tasks.validation: Manual cross-reference review + standalone live scenarios.

tasks.objective: **Audit Andino specialist handoff across all routes.** Ensure active Andino plan/checkpoint remains authoritative; return current research phase/state/evidence/locked decisions/open questions/consistency/risks/artifacts/verification/recommended research action.
tasks.acceptance: Handoff packet can be incorporated by Andino without lifecycle conflict.
tasks.validation: Compare against current Andino routing/handoff; live combined scenario if available.

tasks.objective: **Add coexistence/activation supplemental evals.** Add explicit Andino active/inactive, unrelated question, ordinary coding, small academic edit, and unavailable-tool/evidence scenarios not fully represented by the 110 initial cases.
tasks.acceptance: Negative triggers do not activate full methodology; Andino case shows single owner; unavailable tools remain UNVERIFIED/needs action.

tasks.objective: **Run regression against existing skills and validator policy.** Confirm validator/CI changes and new branch do not alter runtime contents or expected eval schema/behavior of existing two skills.
tasks.acceptance: Existing validator/unit/eval schema checks remain green; package trees unchanged.

tasks.objective: **Consolidate reference boundaries and progressive disclosure.** Review SKILL/reference/assets for duplication, circular/deep chains, oversized files, cross-links, and accidental load-all behavior; split/merge only when evidence improves context efficiency.
tasks.acceptance: No broken links, no duplicated methodology ownership, no reference chain requiring bulk-load, no orphan required component.
tasks.validation: Repo link validator + manual routing/context review; Agent Skills spec checklist.

tasks.objective: **Audit complete SRS traceability.** For every 146 FRs, 47 NFRs, 142 acceptance criteria, 32 scope capabilities, and 110 initial eval cases, point to implementation component, task, and evidence; resolve gaps without adding out-of-scope features.
tasks.acceptance: No in-scope item lacks an implementation owner/evidence path; no out-of-scope item is promoted.
tasks.validation: Automated ID/count check plus manual requirement review.

tasks.objective: **Run full deterministic validation.** Run repository validator against three refs, unit tests, diff checks, YAML/frontmatter/link/path validation; cross-check current Agent Skills spec. Optionally run `skills-ref` in an isolated environment if available, without adding it as repo dependency unless a material gap justifies that decision.
tasks.acceptance: All mandatory deterministic checks pass; unrun optional cross-check is labeled UNVERIFIED, not PASS.
tasks.validation: Repo commands + optional isolated spec validator.

tasks.objective: **Complete semantic review of every eval oracle.** Review all 110 SRS cases plus supplemental cases against runtime instructions without running the skill; ensure expected/forbidden statements are observable and not answer-key leakage.
tasks.acceptance: Every case has a clear owner and no contradictory oracle; negative-trigger coverage is explicit.

tasks.objective: **Execute live behavioral eval suite.** Run each applicable initial and supplemental case one at a time in a disposable context with expected/forbidden hidden from the active skill; record host, skill commit/ref, fixture/context, observed output/action, reviewer verdict.
tasks.acceptance: Every executed case has PASS/FAIL with evidence. Any unexecutable case is UNVERIFIED with blocker/next action. Full v0.9 VERIFIED requires no unresolved must-have behavioral case.
tasks.validation: Live host evaluation/manual reviewer protocol based on repository eval README.

tasks.objective: **Review activation, negative triggers, and context loading.** Test thesis/research activation plus non-trigger cases, small edits, ordinary coding/fact questions; observe whether only relevant references are loaded and whether context remains bounded.
tasks.acceptance: Skill activates when useful, avoids over-activation, and does not bulk-load unrelated methodology.

tasks.objective: **Run final Andino coexistence and existing-skill regression.** Execute combined lifecycle scenario and deterministic regression for existing skills after all changes.
tasks.acceptance: Andino retains authoritative state; all three package checks green; existing skill refs unchanged unless separately authorized.

tasks.objective: **Run authorized remote CI/integration gate.** After explicit user authorization and only then, push required refs/PR state so GitHub Actions can fetch the new distribution branch and run current workflow; record run URL/status.
tasks.dependencies: All local P11 checks pass + explicit authorization.
tasks.acceptance: Remote workflow executes validator/tests against intended refs and passes.
tasks.validation: Inspect the actual GitHub Actions run, checked-out refs, job results, and failures.

tasks.objective: **Produce release-readiness evidence packet.** Summarize implemented components, exact revisions, validations, eval verdicts, known limitations/unknowns, deviations, and remaining authorization gates.
tasks.acceptance: Packet demonstrates every DoD item or names its blocker.
